## question

Compare two cooling retrofit options for a warehouse.

## audience

Operations manager

## scope

Synthetic integration fixture: two options; preserve reliability conditions.

## output

English decision memo

## depth

Explain cost and reliability trade-offs

## evidence_standard

Use supplied inputs; do not turn a pilot into a population estimate.
report:
# Warehouse cooling retrofit

Both pilots imply a five-year simple payback (100/20 and 140/28). That equality does not establish equal operating reliability: the A pilot excludes peak-load days, while B includes them. With peak-load continuity now decisive, B has the more relevant operating evidence. Confirm site fit before commitment; neither pilot establishes a general failure rate.

Sources: [A pilot](sources/a.md), [B pilot](sources/b.md).
